title: Director - Business Consulting
jobDescription:
We are hiring!!

Role Title: Presales Consultant / Business & Solutions Consultant – RA.

Experience: 8+ Years

About the ROLE:

Subex is looking for a high-impact Presales Consultant / Business & Solutions Consultant – Revenue Assurance to drive strategic business development and presales engagements for our Revenue Assurance (RA) product portfolio and Managed Services offerings.

This role requires a strong telecom Revenue Assurance domain expert who can combine deep operational understanding with consultative selling skills. You will work closely with Sales leadership, engage with CXOs, shape winning strategies, and drive opportunities from qualification through successful closure.

If you thrive in complex telecom environments, enjoy solving business problems, and can translate customer challenges into compelling solution narratives — this role is for you.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive end-to-end presales engagements for Subex’s Revenue Assurance solutions and services.

  • Partner with Regional Sales Leaders to build account plans and achieve order intake targets.

  • Identify, qualify, and progress opportunities with a clear win strategy.

  • Provide technical qualification of sales opportunities.
  • Own solution design and responses for RFI/RFP/RFQ submissions.

  • Translate customer requirements into solution architecture and commercial inputs.

  • Lead feasibility assessments, proposal creation, bid defense, and due diligence.

  • Conduct solution workshops, demos, and Proof of Concepts (POCs).

  • Ensure proposal accuracy, quality, and competitiveness.
  • Engage in consultative, insight-driven discussions with stakeholders up to Cx O level.

  • Facilitate workshops and strategy sessions to uncover key business drivers.

  • Defend proposals at customer locations alongside sales teams.

  • Represent Subex in industry forums, conferences, and client presentations.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years of experience in Telecom Revenue Assurance, Billing, or BSS solutions in roles.
  • Solid knowledge of finance and BSS ecosystems including Billing, ERP, CRM, and Cost Management.

  • Experience with complex enterprise software systems and architectures.

  • Exposure to AI / Gen AI / AI Agents and their role in telecom operations.

  • Understanding of 5G, Cloud Transformation, and Digital Transformation programs.

  • Participation in at least one large-scale telecom transformation initiative with insights into success and failure drivers.

  • Strong understanding of change management across people, processes, systems, and data.
  • Ability to think strategically while managing execution details.

  • Strong customer empathy and consultative engagement skills.

  • Excellent listening, analytical, and problem-solving capability.

  • Confident workshop facilitation and stakeholder management.

  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity and drive clarity.

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and documentation skills.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s Degree / B.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.

  • MBA preferred.

  • Finance or Accounting certification is an added advantage.

Why Join Subex?

  • Be part of a global leader in telecom analytics and Revenue Assurance.

  • Engage with leading telecom operators worldwide.

  • Drive impactful transformation initiatives.

  • Work at the intersection of domain expertise, technology, and strategy.

Apply Now: Interested candidates may:

Email their detailed resume to rahul.k@subex.com

OR

🌐 Apply via the Subex Careers Portal.

title: Senior Consultant - Business Consulting
jobDescription:
We are hiring!!

Role Title: Consultant – Business / Revenue Assurance
Experience: 5–6 Years

Role Overview:

Subex is seeking a motivated Business / Revenue Assurance Consultant with strong telecom domain expertise to support assurance and consulting engagements across global operators.

This role requires solid understanding of telecom revenue streams, risk areas, and operational processes, along with the ability to engage customers, conduct workshops, and contribute to solution development.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Analyze telecom revenue streams (prepaid, postpaid, interconnect, roaming, fixed line) and identify associated risk areas.

  • Support consulting engagements by understanding customer environments and recommending assurance solutions.

  • Conduct workshops to gather business requirements and align stakeholders.

  • Perform research on emerging telecom assurance areas and industry trends.

  • Collaborate effectively as an individual contributor or team member to achieve project goals.

  • Prepare documentation, analysis, and presentations using MS Office tools.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5–6 years of experience in Business Assurance / Revenue Assurance within telecom.

  • Strong understanding of telecom call flows and customer lifecycle processes.

  • Knowledge of revenue risk areas across mobile and fixed networks.

  • Familiarity with TM Forum or RAG Business Assurance Framework (preferred).

  • Basic understanding of advanced technologies such as RPA, AI, or ML (preferred).

  • Certifications from TM Forum, RAG, GSMA, or CFCA are an added advantage.

  • Good communication, analytical, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Why Join Subex?

  • Work on strategic Revenue Assurance engagements with global telecom operators.

  • Gain exposure to advanced assurance frameworks and emerging technologies.

  • Be part of a domain-driven consulting team shaping telecom risk management.

Interested candidates may share their resume at rahul.k@subex.com

OR apply through the Subex Careers Portal.

title: Product Head - RA
location: Pritech Park – SEZ, Block -09, 4th Floor B Wing, Survey No. 51 to 64/4, Outer Ring Road, Bellandur V, Bangalore, Karnataka , India
jobDescription:
We are hiring!!

ROLE: Product Manager – Revenue Assurance Solutions
Experience: 10+ Years (4–5 in Product Management)

Role Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the strategy and execution of Subex’s Revenue Assurance and Business Assurance product portfolio. You will drive product vision, customer insight, and business outcomes while partnering with cross‑functional teams to deliver innovative assurance solutions powered by Gen AI.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Define and drive product strategy based on deep customer, market, and domain insights.

  • Lead product lifecycle from ideation to launch and post‑launch improvements.

  • Collaborate with engineering, AI/ML, UX, and go‑to‑market teams to build scalable product features.

  • Analyze usage, revenue, and adoption data to inform decisions and prioritize work.

  • Conduct customer research, interviews, and feedback sessions to shape product direction.

  • Support successful GTM launches and measure product performance against KPIs.

  • Track industry trends, competitive landscape, and evolving technologies including AI/ML.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 10+ years of industry experience with 4–5+ years in product management, ideally in telecom or assurance domains.

  • Strong understanding of telecom revenue assurance, customer workflows, and product value drivers.

  • Proven ability to translate customer needs into product solutions.

  • Experience working with data, APIs, modern software architectures, and AI/ML concepts.

  • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

  • MBA from a leading B‑School and engineering background preferred.

Why Join Subex?

  • Lead product innovation in Gen AI‑driven assurance solutions.

  • Work with global telecom operators and cross‑disciplinary teams.

  • Impact product roadmap and business outcomes.

Send your resume to rahul.k@subex.com

OR apply via Subex Careers Portal.

location: Pritech Park – SEZ, Block -09, 4th Floor B Wing, Survey No. 51 to 64/4, Outer Ring Road, Bellandur V, Bangalore, Karnataka , India
jobDescription:
We are hiring!!

Role Title: Senior Technical Product Manager – Revenue Assurance
Experience: 10+ Years (4–5+ years in product management)

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager – Revenue Assurance Solutions to define strategy and drive execution for Subex’s assurance product portfolio. You will bring deep customer insight, strong business acumen, and domain expertise to shape product vision, guide development, and deliver solutions that meet market needs. The role requires collaboration with cross‑functional teams including engineering, data science, AI/ML, UX, sales, and marketing, while remaining accountable for measurable product outcomes and business impact.

  • Act as a domain leader with deep understanding of customer needs, workflows, and buying behaviors to inform product decisions.

  • Use data (usage, revenue, adoption, performance metrics) to prioritize features and shape product direction.

  • Understand how Subex’s business works — balancing cost, revenue, profitability, and strategy.

  • Track market trends, competitive landscape, technology shifts, and industry standards to maintain product differentiation.

  • Collaborate with designers and engineering teams to define solutions and deliver market‑ready products.

  • Lead product lifecycle from ideation, prototyping, launch, to post‑release improvements.

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on GTM strategy, positioning, and product visibility.

  • Drive execution with clarity and ownership, ensuring alignment to business goals and product KPIs.

  • Minimum 10+ years of industry experience with at least 4–5+ years in product management, preferably in telecom assurance or related enterprise solutions.

  • Strong understanding of telecom domain, customer value drivers, and product economics.

  • Demonstrated success running product strategy and GTM execution with measurable outcomes.

  • Ability to translate customer insights and data into product requirements and prioritization.

  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams including engineering, AI/ML, data science, and UX.

  • Technical fluency to engage in solution trade‑offs with understanding of APIs, architectures, and AI/ML capabilities.

  • Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience with LLMs, NLP, AI coding environments, or advanced analytics is a plus.

  • Good understanding of security, scalability, and infrastructure concepts.

Why Join Subex?

  • Lead Product innovation in Gen AI‑driven Revenue Assurance solutions.

  • Shape product roadmaps with direct impact on business growth and market leadership.

title: Product Head - FMS
location: Pritech Park – SEZ, Block -09, 4th Floor B Wing, Survey No. 51 to 64/4, Outer Ring Road, Bellandur V, Bangalore, Karnataka , India
jobDescription:
We are hiring!!

Role Title: Product Manager – Fraud Management Solutions
Location: Open
Experience: 10+ Years (with 4–5+ years in product management)

Role Overview:

Subex is a global leader in Telecom Fraud Management with a mission to make every digital journey fearless, seamless, and fraud‑free. We are enhancing our flagship fraud management solutions with autonomous assurance, Gen AI‑enabled investigation agents, and market‑leading capabilities.

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager – Fraud Management Solutions who can lead product strategy, execution, and innovation to capture fast‑growing global telecom fraud detection market opportunities.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Define and drive product strategy grounded in deep customer, data, market, and business insights.

  • Understand and balance constraints from Sales, Marketing, Service, Finance, Legal, and Privacy to inform product decisions.

  • Collaborate with design, engineering, data science, AI/ML, and UX teams to build and deliver scalable solutions.

  • Track customer behavior, usage, and revenue data to inform roadmap and measure product success.

  • Lead the full product lifecycle — ideation, prototyping, launch, and post‑release iterations.

  • Monitor industry trends, competitive movements, and emerging technology to maintain differentiation.

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on GTM strategy, product visibility, and revenue growth.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 10+ years of industry experience with 4–5+ years in product management, preferably in fraud management, telecom, or adjacent domains.

  • Proven practical experience designing, building, and launching successful products.

  • Strong business acumen with understanding of costs, revenue drivers, and profitability.

  • Excellent understanding of customer needs, workflows, adoption patterns, and strategic value drivers.

  • Experience working with AI/ML models, APIs, architectures, and modern data platforms.

  • Ability to guide engineering discussions with technical insight and product clarity.

  • Experience with LLMs, NLP, computer vision, recommendation systems, or AI environments is a plus.

  • Solid grasp of security, scalability, and infrastructure fundamentals.

  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Desired QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Graduate/Postgraduate in Engineering from a premier institute.

  • MBA from a leading B‑School (preferred).

Why Join Subex?

  • Lead innovation in autonomous and Gen AI‑enabled fraud management products.

  • Influence market‑leading product direction in a fast‑growing telecom risk space.

  • Collaborate with global teams and cross‑disciplinary experts to shape impactful solutions.

Interested candidates may share their detailed resume to rahul.k@subex.com
OR
Apply via the Subex Careers Portal.

title: Senior Principal Consultant
jobDescription:
We are hiring!!

Role Title: Sr Principal Consultant – Revenue Assurance
Experience: 15+ Years

Role Overview:

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Advisor – Telecom Assurance & Risk with deep domain expertise in TMT (Telecom, Media & Technology) and a strong understanding of Business Assurance, Revenue Assurance, and Fraud domains. The role focuses on process re‑engineering, risk analysis, and providing high‑value consulting insights and solutions to complex client challenges.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Bring broad and deep expertise in the TMT domain to assess business and operational risk areas.

  • Lead end‑to‑end process re‑engineering initiatives and perform risk analysis across assurance domains.

  • Understand and evaluate Business Assurance, Revenue Assurance, and Fraud management concepts and frameworks.

  • Apply knowledge of end‑to‑end BSS/OSS architectures and technologies to identify improvement opportunities.

  • Leverage understanding of Customer Life Cycle, Order‑to‑Cash, and foundational revenue & cost accounting principles.

  • Conduct research on new areas, emerging trends, and risks, and bring actionable insights to clients.

  • Translate complex client problem statements into valuable, practical solutions.

  • Prepare and deliver high‑impact presentations and articulate insights clearly to stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 15+ years of industry experience with a strong understanding of the TMT domain.

  • Solid knowledge of Business Assurance, Revenue Assurance, and Fraud management.

  • Experience in process re‑engineering, risk analysis, and strategic solutioning.

  • Familiarity with BSS/OSS architectures and telecom operational frameworks.

  • Understanding of customer lifecycle, order‑to‑cash flows, and basic revenue/cost accounting.

  • Strong research capabilities and ability to produce high‑value insights.

  • Excellent presentation, communication, and articulation skills.

Added Advantage:

  • Experience with RAFM or similar assurance systems (preferred but not mandatory).

  • Exposure to industry bodies such as TM Forum, RAG, CFCA, or other leading communities.

  • Process or quality certifications such as Six Sigma, e TOM, ITIL, etc.

Why Join Us?

  • Engage in high‑impact advisory work with leading global telecom operators.

  • Leverage deep domain expertise to shape business and operational assurance strategies.

  • Work in a collaborative environment with seasoned practitioners across assurance domains.

Interested candidates may share their detailed resume to rahul.k@subex.com.
OR
Apply via the Subex Careers Portal.
